title: Laravel Delivery Lifecycle Standard
description: Registry metadata for the Laravel delivery lifecycle standard (maleolabs/anvil-standard-laravel): the distributable unit of Laravel framework lifecycle knowledge for the Anvil Runtime. This document is the source manifest of the standard; the release pipeline publishes the release-specific metadata document (same identity, release version, content digests and attestation over the release artifact) per ADR-030 and TS-016-03-02.
